A gate reading this repository will go on reporting such an item as outstanding in every clone, forever; that is expected, is not a regression, and the gate must say so rather than leave a reader to re-raise it.

Workflow Definition Language has no hash function and no bitwise operators, so the only route inside Power Automate is an inline-code action, and the operator confirmed on 2026-09-03 that this tenant cannot run one. 29 assertions holding the kit to the patched definition: the pasted scope byte-identical, no Initialize variable inside a package, every variable the paste touches present in the build table and none spare, every connector action bound to the api it uses, the trigger equal to the contract, and BUILD.md naming the old flow and what stays reachable until it is off. items.description: AUTO_SCHEDULED_SWEEP's first live run returned status 400, 'The attempted operation is prohibited because it exceeds the list view threshold', twice — once for Get_Ack_Overdue and once for Get_Due_Breached. Global Tracking Queue held 15,804 items at capture, three times SharePoint's 5,000 threshold, and both queries filtered AND sorted on a date column carrying no index, so neither could be resolved. The threshold applies twice over and both halves had to be answered: the query must be resolvable through an index, AND the clause it resolves must return under 5,000 rows. 'DueDate lt now' on a task list is every task ever due, which no index makes small. The flow now asks for a 30-day window ordered newest-first, which is the code half; the columns still need indexes, which is this item. Three further targets are latent rather than live: DGO_FETCH_ALL sorts both big lists on Modified and DGO_GET_DOCS sorts DGO DIGITAL OPS on it with no filter at all when no reference is supplied — past the threshold SharePoint refuses to SORT on an unindexed column exactly as it refuses to filter on one, so the boot call fails the same way the moment that package is pasted.

evidence.states: the run id, its timings, five scopes Succeeded, no errors — and what it does not establish
the bounded filters the run exercised
the index pass that was the other half

items.title: Two detectors for the threshold read only equality filters, which is why this shipped
items.description: The preflight generator and tests/index-targets.test.mjs both extracted filtered columns with the pattern '<Col> eq ', and neither looked at $orderby at all. The scheduled sweep filtered with 'lt' and sorted on the same column, so both detectors saw nothing, the preflight printed READY TO PASTE, and the flow was imported. A check written to catch exactly this class of failure could not see the instance of it that reached production. Both now read eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge plus startswith and substringof, and both read $orderby. The preflight's mustIndex also stopped being an intersection with a curated list — a column could previously only be reported as needing an index if someone had already written it down, which makes the check incapable of finding anything new. It is now driven by the size of the list, which is the property the threshold actually depends on.
